verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never states Modal's billing granularity (per-second or per-minute) or that charges accrue only while containers run. The closest items, fast container spin-up/down (modal-docs-10) and endpoints that "idle at zero" (modal-docs-14), describe scaling behavior rather than a documented billing model, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit. Workspace budgets cover spend limits, not metering granularity.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running
